description.value: COBS Bread is a Canadian franchise bakery (part of the Australian Bakers Delight group) with roughly 190 locations across Canada, including this Shelbourne Plaza outpost in Victoria. Every item — loaves, scones, cruffins, croissants, bagels, and savoury treats — is baked from scratch on-site daily with no added preservatives. Unsold baked goods at day's end are donated to local charities, making it a reliable stop for fresh carbohydrates on a touring ride.
